## s20 — C1 (song essay)

**SUMMARY.** It chews everything a final time: icon adored (1–2), devotees bowed (3), play affirmed (4–5), couple celebrated (6), meditation rooted (7), itch scratched into pillar (8), ever-fed ever-playing ever-eating Lord (9), no going, His abode seen (10), wealth and poverty begging nothing (11), pain-pleasure-poison-nectar-saṃsāra-liberation transmuted (12), no suffering yet we sink — tell why (13), light begged even by others (14), no prayer, Name on lip (15), recognition as agency (16), all beings grasped (17), all-beyond-Me false by destruction-play (18), meditated form standing present (19), vetāla-roused night-dance (20), the limb-begun praise made unending (21).

*Rasa: ānanda (bliss) with adbhuta (wonder) — The sthāyibhāva is devotion (bhakti) in the mode of chewing (carvaṇa); the vyabhicāri is joy (harṣa) at everything transmuted. The rasa is the bliss of final chewing — pain/pleasure/poison/nectar/saṃsāra/liberation all transmuted. Abhinava's rasa theory frames this as ānanda: the relish (camatkāra) of the Absolute chewed to the end. Lakshmanjoo: chewing (carvaṇa) — everything transmuted. Pain/pleasure/poison/nectar/saṃsāra/liberation all chewed. The rasa is the bliss of final chewing — the Absolute tasted to the end. Carvaṇa as a whole song (cf. Stotra 6).*
